headline: Weathered Expanse Stays Busiest; Farranac Coast and Fisherman's Row Report Flips
war_summary: Since the last edition, the war's 131st day, Weathered Expanse remains the busiest front: seven more strategic-base events in the latest two hours lift its day total to twenty-six, with Necropolis logging fourteen events and Spirit Watch and Wightwalk five apiece. Fisherman's Row added three fresh flips, holding a thirty-six-event day; Peripti Landing and Arcadia lead the list. Stlican Shelf recorded two more events, and Farranac Coast added three, centered on Mara. Godcrofts also produced two recent flips around Exile and Lipsia. Lykos Isle has fallen quiet in the latest two hours but still shows a twenty-one-event day, with five apiece at Fort Guile, Mārudia, and The Squall. DeadLands, quiet in the latest two-hour ledger, has registered three events in six hours—Callahan's Boot the focus. Oarbreaker's flurry has cooled, and Tempest Island has faded further. Heavy casualties persist in Weathered Expanse, Farranac Coast, DeadLands, and Stlican Shelf, and no victor has been declared.
